name: scroll-text-reveal
title: Scroll Text Reveal
description: A paragraph whose words light up one by one as it scrolls up the screen. Shows all the text under reduced motion.

props.name: text
props.description: The text. Screen readers read it as one string.

props.name: offset
props.description: Where the reveal starts and ends, as scroll offsets of the text against the viewport.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the scroll link off and shows all of the text.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
